title: How to Best Use AI for Sales Prospecting
summary: An actionable guide to implementing AI in your sales process to drive more leads
body_text: The use of AI for sales prospecting is one of the most talked-about topics amongst sales leaders this year. And honestly, it's because many companies aren't getting it right. But sales prospecting is an EXCELLENT use case for AI. It just needs to be executed carefully, intentionally, and with the help of an exceptional tool and team to back it. In this article, we'll help you approach incorporating AI into your sales processes and help you do so in a way that's both strategic and effective. We'll specifically dive into… How AI Is Revamping Sales Prospecting How Human BDRs and AI BDRs Can Work Best Together Features to Look For in an AI Sales Prospecting Tool The Top Five AI Sales Prospecting Tools The Best Practices for Using AI for Sales Prospecting Let's do this! How AI is Revamping Sales Prospecting Sales prospecting has often been one of the most grind-heavy tasks in sales. There's a deep hustle required to master tasks like finding leads, following up, and building first connections. And with the help of AI, those mundane lead finding and follow-up tasks can be automated instantly, leaving sales teams time to master imperative higher-value activities like perfecting their pitch, overcoming objections, and measuring and iterating on success. AI can even help sales teams become even more effective with those high-value activities by handling tasks like analyzing customer data patterns to identify high-intent prospects, providing a real-time analysis of buyer behavior to help reps know exactly when to follow up and how, and even handling pipeline reporting. But that's a lot, right? And knowing where and how to start can feel overwhelming. Fortunately, utilizing AI BDRs is one of the most approachable ways to start implementing AI into your prospecting process, and it requires no technical expertise. How Human BDRs & AI BDRs Can Work Best Together AI employees are designed to work alongside human employees, not replace them. The collaboration between human and AI BDRs can lead to increased productivity and efficiency, and result in more closed deals, but there's a balance that needs to be perfected to do so. Below, we dive into the specific ways human BDRs and AI BDRs can work well together. Tackling Large Volumes of Tasks The nature of BDR work is inherently task-intensive. From identifying potential leads to sending follow-up emails and scheduling calls, the volume of tasks can quickly become overwhelming. AI can automate many of these repetitive tasks, allowing human BDRs to focus on more strategic and high-impact activities. Processing Large Quantities of Data BDRs are frequently swamped with a deluge of information, from their target customers' pain points to prospect activity, and learning when and how to best act on it. Sifting through this manually is not only time-consuming but also prone to errors. AI has the capability to swiftly process large volumes of data, offering actionable insights for more informed decision-making. Finding Ways to See Success in Cold Outreach Once a dependable approach, cold outreach is now met with increasing indifference. Prospects are more prone to disregard unsolicited messages, resulting in diminished response rates. AI can be leveraged to pinpoint optimal outreach times and to compose tailored messages that better engage potential clients. Personalizing Outreach at Scale AI tools are adept at analyzing historical interactions and customer behaviors to craft highly personalized outreach strategies. This level of personalization can lead to a substantial increase in engagement rates, making it easier for BDRs to connect with prospects and cultivate meaningful relationships. Furthermore, AI can write in your exact tone of voice, so you sound consistent and personable. Features to Look For in an AI Sales Prospecting Tool With so many AI sales prospecting tools on the market, it's challenging to sort through and identify the best options. Later in this article, we'll share four of our favorite AI sales prospecting tools, but below, we wanted to call out all the most critical aspects sales leaders should be considering when selecting an AI partner. Scalability Your AI sales prospecting tool should be scalable to grow with your business. Whether you're a small startup or a large enterprise, the tool should handle increasing volumes of data and users seamlessly. Look for solutions that offer flexible pricing and can adapt to your changing needs. Integrations Integrations are a crucial component in the optimization of your AI sales prospecting tool. A seamless connection to your CRM, email marketing platforms, project management solution, meeting assistants, and other tools is essential. This ensures a streamlined workflow and consistent data synchronization, which in turn bolsters your sales process. Motion, for example, offers hundreds of integrations with tools many sales teams use daily via our API and integrations. Motion specifically natively integrates with tools like Salesforce, Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Meet, Zoom, Zapier, Microsoft Outlook, Microsoft Teams, and iCloud Calendar. Robust Data Privacy & Security Data privacy is a paramount concern in sales, which is why finding an AI tool that prioritizes data security and compliance is a necessity. For instance, Motion offers enterprise-grade security and data protection. Motion is SOC 2 Type 2 compliant, ensuring the highest security standards through an independent audit by a top security firm. All data is fully encrypted in transit and at rest to keep your information safe. The Top Four AI Sales Prospecting Tools Below, we're recapping the top AI sales tools and diving into their most loved features. We also took the time to deep dive into user reviews and showcase some of the areas where each tool is thriving, as well as the areas where they could improve. Motion AI As already mentioned, Motion offers an entire team of AI employees that can help a variety of different departments within your organization. One of our AI employees, Chip, is an AI sales representative. Chip helps teams by streamlining routine tasks, taking much of the burden of sales operations off AE and SDRs. In doing so, this empowers sales experts to concentrate on their core strength—building relationships. Some common tasks you'll see Chip handle are CRM updates based on calls and emails, lead research and custom outreach via email, and post-call coaching of SDRs and BDRs. Key Features Develop custom-built AI Employees specific to your own business needs with the help of Motion's Engineering Team Expansive feature set for work and project management, including AI Projects, AI Tasks, AI Calendars, AI Notes, AI Docs, AI SOPs, AI Search, AI Reports, and more. Create your own AI Employees and Skills in minutes with no technical requirements, based on templated skills Access hundreds of integrations with tools you already use Feel secure with enterprise-grade security User Feedback Motion is an incredibly expansive tool that makes it an ideal place to manage AI employees because it already houses the knowledge of your organization or business. Their AI employees, for example, can take meeting recordings (that Motion also captures), extract key tasks, assign them to teammates, and write a summary to Slack so people who are interested in continuing the discussion can do so offline. That is just an example workflow amongst tens of thousands. With that being said, small business owners have found Motion to be a bit expensive. However, it's important to note that once you've implemented Motion, you should be able to cancel many of your other tools, which will ultimately save your team money. Apollo.io Apollo.io is an AI-powered sales platform that helps revenue teams find and engage leads, automate outreach, manage deals, and enrich data. It integrates with a wide range of tools and offers a comprehensive feature set to support every stage of the sales cycle. With Apollo, teams are booking more meetings, increasing their email open rates, and finding more direct contact information Apollo's end-to-end platform helps businesses of all sizes, including Autodesk, Cyera, and DocuSign. Key Features Find the right people and book quality meetings Turn conversations into deals with AI assistance Keep your data up-to-date, all the time, with enrichment Run your entire sales cycle on unified customer data User Feedback Apollo's robust feature set and intuitive interface are its hallmarks. The platform is highly adaptable, allowing you to customize it to your team's unique requirements. However, users often question the accuracy of contact data and are disappointed in the fact that they often just provide business phone numbers, as opposed to direct lines. Piperdrive Piperdrive is an AI-powered CRM that seamlessly integrates with your existing sales tools. It automates data entry and follow-ups, allowing BDRs to concentrate on high-impact activities. The platform's intuitive interface and robust features make it a valuable asset for any sales team looking to streamline their processes. Key Features Customer relationship management Sales pipeline and deals Automation Insights and reporting Email and communication tracking User Feedback Pipedrive is consistently praised for the fact that it's extremely approachable and easy to use. Additionally, users love its drag-and-drop sales pipeline, which allows them to intuitively manage deals and track progress with minimal training. As far as negatives are concerned, Pipedrive is best used by small to medium-sized businesses, so its enterprise functionality is limited. Finally, users often comment that it lacks a ton of features, preventing it from being a fully comprehensive CRM solution. UserGems UserGems employs AI to rank and prioritize leads according to their conversion potential. This empowers BDRs to concentrate on the most promising prospects, heightening their likelihood of success. The platform also furnishes comprehensive analytics and reports, enabling you to monitor performance and fine-tune your approaches. Key Features Choose your signal-based campaigns Create, enrich, and capture signals Accounts and contact scoring Add to campaigns and draft messaging User Feedback UserGems has a ton of really positive user reviews. Their clients love how the product can surface warm leads at exactly the right time. The platform's intuitive interface and comprehensive database make tracking and reaching out to these individuals a seamless process. Of course, there are areas where users feel the tool could improve. Specifically, multiple people have commented that the amount of data the tool provides can feel a bit overwhelming. Artisan Artisan is an outbound email sales platform that relies on an AI BDR to handle the entire outbound demand generation process. Artisan's AI BDR can create Target Customer Personas, prospect with a database of over 300,000,000 contacts, create and send highly bespoke email sequences, and even directly book meetings on account execs' calendars. Key Features Over 300 million B2B data contacts Email warmup Automated multichannel outreach Outbound automation User Feedback Of all the tools we've reviewed, Artisan, unfortunately, has the least favorable reviews. Users do appreciate the amount of time the tool saves their team, and how easy it is to set up a campaign. Alternatively, some users report that the outreach efforts are of low quality and it's clear that they were created by AI. Best Practices for Using AI for Sales Prospecting Because AI is already taking sales prospecting by storm, we're unfortunately already hearing quite a few stories of it being used improperly and negatively impacting a company's reputation as a result. We highly encourage you to think through each of the areas below to ensure you're using AI as tactfully and professionally as possible. Ensure Your Personalization Efforts Are Accurate Personalization is a critical component of effective sales prospecting. AI tools can help by analyzing customer data to create tailored messages. However, it's important to ensure the accuracy of this data. Inaccurate personalization can result in a poor customer experience and diminish the effectiveness of your outreach. Work with a Team of AI Engineers Teaming up with AI engineers can greatly amplify the effectiveness of your sales prospecting. They are adept at fine-tuning AI algorithms to meet your specific needs and ensure peak performance. Regular consultations with these experts can keep you ahead of the curve and maximize your ROI. Motion offers support to its clients from its world-class engineering team and can help them create custom AI employees for their business needs. Remember That Every Customer Touchpoint Matters Each interaction with a potential customer is a chance to foster trust and solidify a relationship. AI is a powerful tool in ensuring that every touchpoint is both timely and pertinent. From the first contact to subsequent emails, each message should be meticulously composed to captivate the prospect and propel them through the sales pipeline. Double-check all of your AI-drafted content, enhance and edit when necessary, and even remove AI content when you're at a pivotal selling moment. Think Past ChatGPT for AI Sales Prospecting While ChatGPT is a powerful AI tool for text generation, it is only one piece of the AI puzzle in sales prospecting. To truly excel, BDRs need a comprehensive solution that goes beyond text generation. This means integrating tools that can handle the entire sales process, from lead identification to follow-up. Additionally, it's important to remember that sales is a workflow. You don't want your reps to just randomly use ChatGPT for their one-off requests. The result of this would be lack knowledge sharing and best pracrices across the team. Instead, they should consistently automate their most important tasks in a workflow that is built and run on an AI tool that uniquely understands your business, customers, tone, and preferences. Utilize any of the seven AI employees mentioned in this post, or custom-build AI Employees specific to your own business needs with the help of Motion's forward-deployed engineers. title: Research Solutions Launches Scite Rankings: A New Standard For Measuring Research Veracity & Influence
summary: New Scite Rankings addresses longstanding limitation in traditional academic evaluation methods, providing new insight into research impact and veracity.
body_text: New Rankings Method Addresses Longstanding Limitation In Traditional Academic Evaluation Methods, Providing New Insight Into Research Impact & Veracity HENDERSON, Nev., Oct. 8, 2025 /PRNewswire/ -- Research Solutions, Inc. (NASDAQ: RSSS), a leading provider of AI-powered scientific research tools, today announced the launch of Scite Rankings , the first global research ranking system built on artificial intelligence-driven citation analysis. Unlike traditional rankings that reward citation volume alone, Scite Rankings evaluates how research is cited, whether work is supported, contrasted, or simply mentioned, offering a more accurate and trustworthy measure of scientific influence across institutions, journals, and disciplines. “For decades, research evaluation has been shaped by blunt instruments like Impact Factor and h-Index, which treat all citations equally,” said Dr. Josh Nicholson, Chief Strategy Officer at Research Solutions. “Scite Rankings signals a turning point. By assessing not just how often work is cited but the quality and context of those citations, we enable universities, investors, and policymakers to make evidence-based decisions about where to direct resources and build partnerships.” At the heart of the system is Scite’s Smart Citations technology, which has processed more than 1.4 billion citation statements, creating the world’s largest database of contextualized citation intelligence. This sophisticated AI categorizes citations as supporting, contrasting, or neutral, revealing a detailed picture of how research is received and validated by the scientific community. The result is the Scite Index , a next-generation metric that blends traditional bibliometrics with citation context. Early results show dramatic differences from conventional rankings. For example, while the University of Michigan places 47th in Times Higher Education’s 2025 quality rankings and 21st in Shanghai’s publication-based system, it ranks 8th in Scite’s system due to the high proportion of supporting citations earned by its researchers. “This is more than a new ranking. It is a new lens on the reliability of science,” said Sean Rife, Head of Academic Relations for Scite. “By emphasizing replicability and research reliability, we provide funders, governments, and investors with a clear line of sight into which institutions are delivering dependable research outcomes.” For researchers, Scite Rankings delivers recognition for producing high-quality, reproducible work. For investors and research managers, it creates actionable intelligence for allocating capital, shaping collaborations, and reducing risk in a market where research quality directly impacts funding and innovation pipelines. Full details of the methodology, including validation studies, are available here: https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.05206 . Review the complete Scite Rankings database at https://scite.ai/rankings . About Research Solutions Research Solutions (NASDAQ: RSSS) is a vertical SaaS and AI company that simplifies research workflow for academic institutions, life science companies, and research organizations worldwide. As one of the only publisher-independent marketplaces for scientific, technical, and medical (STM) content, the company uniquely combines AI-powered tools—including an intelligent research assistant and full-text search capabilities—with seamless access to both open access and paywalled research. The platform enables organizations to discover, access, manage, and analyze scientific literature more efficiently, accelerating the pace of scientific discovery. For more information about Research Solutions, visit: www.researchsolutions.com | LinkedIn | Facebook | X SOURCE Research Solutions, Inc. Media inquiries can be directed to Lydia Lindenberg, Director of Content Marketing, llindenberg@researchsolutions.com .

Non-GAAP EPS guide: $21.70–$23.10; consensus: $22.9. Q2 2026 Consensus Revenue: $9,425M; EPS (GAAP): $3.75. Q2 2025 Actuals Revenue: $8,917M (restated); EPS (GAAP): $3.12. Understanding ADLs and IADLs: The Basics of Caregiving Assessments
summary: If you’ve started the process of applying for Medicaid Home and Community Based Services Waivers or any other long-term care services, you’ve likely heard the terms ADLs and IADLs. These aren't just clinical jargon; they are the "measuring sticks" that state assessors use to determine exactly how much help a person needs to remain safely at home.
body_text: If you’ve started the process of applying for Medicaid Home and Community Based Services Waivers or any other long-term care services, you’ve likely heard the terms ADLs and IADLs . These aren't just clinical jargon; they are the "measuring sticks" that state assessors use to determine exactly how much help a person needs to remain safely at home. Understanding these two categories is the first step in knowing whether you or your loved one might qualify for state-funded support for long-term care. 1. Activities of Daily Living (ADLs) – The "Basics" Activities of Daily Living (ADLs) refer to the fundamental, basic routine tasks that most healthy individuals can perform without assistance. Typically, these are the basic skills necessary for individuals to independently care for themselves, such as eating, bathing, and mobility. They are markers of physical independence. If an individual struggles with these, it is often a sign that they need a higher level of hands-on care. These are also the first skills that a case manager, waiver coordinator, or nurse will assess to make a determination on the care needs of an individual. Basic Activities of Daily Living include the following: Personal Hygiene: The ability to bathe and groom oneself and maintain dental hygiene, nail, and hair care. Dressing: The ability to select clothing and put it on without assistance. Feeding: The ability to feed oneself (not including meal preparation). Toileting: The ability to get to and from the toilet and clean oneself. Continence: The ability to control bladder and bowel functions. Mobility/Transferring: The ability to move safely from one position to another (e.g., getting from a bed to a chair) or walk around the home. Assessing ADLs is one way state programs determine if an individual needs daily help and would require ongoing long-term care. 2. Instrumental Activities of Daily Living (IADLs) – The "Life Management" Tasks Instrumental Activities of Daily Living (IADLs) are more complex. They require higher-level thinking, organizational skills, and problem-solving. While these tasks aren’t strictly physical daily tasks, they are essential for living independently in a home and community. These tasks typically occur intermittently and are usually the first tasks that an individual needs help with before requiring help with ADLs. Meal Preparation: The ability to plan, cook, and serve balanced meals while safely operating cooking devices and maintaining safe food storage. Medication Management: The ability to keep track of dosages and ensuring medications are taken on time. Managing Finances: The ability to manage finances, pay bills, managing a budget, and handling money. Housekeeping: The ability to perform light and heavy cleaning (laundry, dusting, vacuuming) and other general home maintenance tasks. Shopping: The ability to go grocery shopping and managing household supplies, maintaining an awareness of what items are needed for sustenance and procuring them. Transportation: The ability to plan for and use transportation like using public transit or driving to get to appointments and errands. Managing Communication: The ability to manage telephone and email. Why Do These Terms Matter to You? When an Area Agency on Aging representative comes to the home for a waiver assessment, they are specifically looking to see if your loved one has "functional deficits" in these areas. Eligibility for Care: Most Medicaid programs require that an individual show a "level of care" deficit. This means if a person can no longer perform a certain number of ADLs or IADLs safely, they become "eligible" for programs like Structured Family Caregiving (SFC). Care Planning: Knowing exactly which tasks are a struggle helps us build a better care plan. For example, if someone is great at ADLs but struggles with IADLs (like medication management and meal prep), they may need a "homemaker" style of support rather than full-time medical assistance. Similarly if an individual requires help with ADLs, they may need "personal care" services in addition to homemaker. When Should You Seek Help? You don’t need to wait for a total loss of independence to start looking for support. If you notice your loved one skipping meals because cooking is too tiring, or if you’re seeing bills pile up because they are confused by the mail, these are "IADL red flags." If you're already doing all of this for them, you are likely eligible for support under Ohio’s waiver programs. Not sure if your loved one meets the "Level of Care" requirements? Navigating the assessment process can be intimidating, but you don't have to do it alone. We help Ohio families understand their eligibility and connect with the right care resources. title: SiriusXM Signs Multi-Year Deal with Hit Comedy Podcast "The Bald and the Beautiful"
summary: Three-year deal brings exclusive distribution to the SiriusXM Podcast Network and exclusive advertising representation through SiriusXM Media NEW…...
body_text: SiriusXM Signs Multi-Year Deal with Hit Comedy Podcast "The Bald and the Beautiful" July 21, 2026 10:00am EDT Download as PDF Three-year deal brings exclusive distribution to the SiriusXM Podcast Network and exclusive advertising representation through SiriusXM Media NEW YORK – July 21, 2026 – SiriusXM today announced a three-year agreement with the hit comedy podcast " The Bald and the Beautiful ," hosted by drag superstars Trixie Mattel and Katya Zamolodchikova . Under the agreement, SiriusXM will exclusively distribute the show through the industry-leading SiriusXM Podcast Network. SiriusXM Media, the company's advertising division, will retain exclusive advertising sales rights for both the audio and video versions of the podcast. Hosted by two of the world's most recognizable drag entertainers, "The Bald and the Beautiful" has become one of comedy's most beloved podcasts, showcasing Trixie and Katya's signature blend of irreverent humor, candid conversations, and off-the-wall observations. Since launching in 2020, the show has earned nearly 100 million lifetime downloads on RSS and become a fixture on the comedy podcast charts. Its popularity extends well beyond audio, with new video episodes regularly drawing hundreds of thousands of viewers on YouTube. The Trixie & Katya YouTube channel has amassed more than 770,000 subscribers and nearly 150 million lifetime views, highlighting the show's success across audio and video and its ability to connect with fans wherever they are. “I am so excited about this incredible opportunity,” said Katya. “It feels surreal joining the SiriusXM family, I am so grateful.” “I can’t believe it! I’m so grateful to be a Sirius girl now,” said Trixie. “SiriusXM just got a whole lot prettier… you’re all welcome.” The addition of "The Bald and the Beautiful" further expands SiriusXM's industry-leading podcast portfolio. With a diverse roster spanning comedy, true crime, wellness, business, and entertainment programming, the SiriusXM Podcast Network represents more of the top 20 podcasts than any other network according to Edison Research, reaching 1 in 2 podcast listeners in the U.S. each month. New episodes of "The Bald and the Beautiful" will continue to be available wherever listeners get their podcasts, including the SiriusXM app and all major podcast platforms. SiriusXM Podcasts+ subscribers will enjoy access to ad free episodes and can sign up directly in Apple Podcasts or on their favorite listening app by visiting siriusxm.com/podcasts-plus-subscription . “The Bald and the Beautiful” and Zamolodchikova, as well as Mattel’s audio and touring work, are represented by UTA. About Trixie Mattel Trixie Mattel is an American singer, actor, drag queen and recognized “Skinny Legend.” Trixie is the winner of “RuPaul’s Drag Race All Stars” season 3 (originally competing on season 7). She is also a Billboard Heatseekers #1 charting recording artist (One Stone, 2018), a wildly successful touring act, and one half of a comic duo with Katya on YouTube (“UNHhhh” & Netflix's "I Like To Watch"). Her Solid Pink Disco DJ tour is nationwide with appearances at Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival, OUTLOUD Music Festival, and opening dates for Chappell Roan. In 2026, she brings her immersive sci-fi-inspired DJ experience to major festivals including Lollapalooza, Bonnaroo Music and Arts Festival, Outside Lands Music and Arts Festival, and more. Trixie is represented by managers Jacob Slane, Maddie Jacobs and David Charpentier at Producer Entertainment Group, and her publicist Josh Page at Shore Fire Media. About Katya Zamolodchikova Brian McCook is an actor, author, and performing artist who, after graduating from Massachusetts College of Art in Boston, began performing as the drag persona Katya Zamolodchikova. Katya achieved notoriety after placing 5th on the 7th season of the reality competition series RuPaul's Drag Race and runner-up on the second season of RuPaul's Drag Race All Stars. In 2019 Katya wrote and performed a solo show which toured North America, Europe, the UK and Australia. Katya and Trixie star in the acclaimed web series UNHhhh (now in its 8th season), as well as Netflix’s I Like to Watch series on YouTube, and also host the award-winning podcast The Bald and the Beautiful on the SiriusXM Podcast Network. They published their first book, Trixie and Katya’s Guide to Modern Womanhood which made its debut on the New York Times Bestseller List in 2020 and they released a follow-up, Working Girls, in 2022. Katya has appeared on television in scripted roles on Hacks, Playing House, Lucifer, Tales of the City, Love Victor, and Room 104 and also as herself in an episode of the viral hit Showtime series Ziwe. Katya is represented by managers David Charpentier, Jacob Slane and Maddie Jacobs at Producer Entertainment Group, and her publicist Josh Page at Shore Fire Media. About Sirius XM Holdings Inc. SiriusXM is the leading audio entertainment company in North America with a portfolio of audio businesses including its flagship subscription entertainment service SiriusXM; the ad-supported and premium music streaming services of Pandora; an expansive podcast network; and a suite of business and advertising solutions. Together, SiriusXM reaches a combined monthly audience of approximately 255 million listeners. SiriusXM offers a broad range of content for listeners everywhere they tune in with a diverse mix of live, on-demand, and curated programming across music, talk, news, and sports. For more about SiriusXM, please visit www.siriusxm.com . Media Contact: SiriusXM: Ron Gaskill, ron.gaskill@siriusxm.com Released July 21, 2026
